sponsored.t: Relates to gun buyback programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to gun buy back programs; requires entities operating such programs to check the serial number of all firearms obtained against the NYSPIN records and to obtain the express permission of the lawful owner of any firearm found to be stolen before the destruction thereof.

sponsored.t: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lt. Gary A. Scott
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lt. Gary A. Scott in the town of LeRoy, county of Genesee.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Batavia to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Batavia to impose a hotel and motel tax not exceeding five percent of the per diem rental rate for each room.

sponsored.t: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Lt. Gary A. Scott Memorial Highway"
sponsored.sum: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Lt. Gary A. Scott Memorial Highway" in the town of LeRoy, county of Genesee.

sponsored.t: Relates to residency requirements for police officers in the village of Medina
sponsored.sum: Relates to residency requirements for police officers in the village of Medina in the county of Orleans.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Michael Hall to file a request for change of benefit coverage with the New York state teachers' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Michael Hall to file a request for change of benefit coverage with the New York state teachers' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town clerk of the town of Bethany, county of Genesee, to be nonresidents of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town clerk of the town of Bethany, county of Genesee, to be nonresidents of such town.

sponsored.t: Provides a state income tax exemption for police officers
sponsored.sum: Provides a state income tax exemption for police officers up to one hundred thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain disabled veterans from real property taxation
sponsored.sum: Exempts disabled veterans rated as such by the US Department of Veterans affairs from real property taxation for their primary residence.

sponsored.t: Provides for procedure in filling vacancies in the offices of comptroller and attorney-general
sponsored.sum: Provides for procedure in filling vacancies in the offices of comptroller and attorney-general.

sponsored.t: NY local food and products sourcing tax credit
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a local food and products sourcing tax credit.

sponsored.t: Relates to landowner recreational liability and farm and horseback riding operation liability relief; and enacts the "equine activity safety code act"
sponsored.sum: Limits the liability of a farm or "u-pick" operation for injuries incurred while a person was picking and buying agricultural products; expands the limited exemption of a property owner from liability to a property owner who makes their premises available to others for any recreational use and to include owners of underdeveloped and/or land used in agricultural production; enacts the "equine activity safety code act".

sponsored.t: Prohibits the DEC from restricting the burning of garbage, refuse or rubbish in an open fire under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the DEC from restricting the burning of garbage, refuse or rubbish in an open fire on land possessed by a single family or any part of a farm under certain circumstances; provides for the repeal of such provisions under the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Provides for a referendum on the question "Do you support the division of New York into two separate states"
sponsored.sum: Provides for a referendum on the question "Do you support the division of New York into two separate states?".

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual
sponsored.sum: Relates to aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual; eliminates the requirement that an incarcerated individual causes or attempts to cause an employee to come into contact with blood, seminal fluid, urine, feces, saliva, or the contents of a toilet bowl by throwing, tossing or expelling such fluid or material.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the registration fee for gold star parent and gold star family member distinctive license plates
sponsored.sum: Provides for distinctive license plates for gold star family members; eliminates the registration fee for gold star parent and gold star family member distinctive license plates.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting cranes from the petroleum business tax
sponsored.sum: Relates to exempting cranes from the petroleum business tax.

sponsored.t: Relates to payment of the governor's salary
sponsored.sum: Requires withholding the governor's salary until the legislative passage of the budget occurs.

sponsored.t: Requires certain meetings between the governor, the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly relating to the state budget to be open to the general public
sponsored.sum: Requires certain meetings between the governor, the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly relating to the state budget to be open to the general public; to provide an opportunity for the public to attend, listen to, and observe such meetings; and to broadcast and maintain records of such meetings on each party's website.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit in the amount of certain fees charged in connection with loans under the federal home loan guarantee program to national guard and reserve vets
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit in the amount of certain fees charged in connection with loans under the federal home loan guarantee program to national guard and reserve veterans.

sponsored.t: Creates a veteran's home and land ownership loan program
sponsored.sum: Creates a veteran's home and land ownership loan program to provide loans to veterans to purchase homes or unimproved land suitable for building; requires such loans to be secured by a second mortgage.

sponsored.t: Exempts veterans eighty-five years of age and older from the obligation to pay New York state income tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts veterans eighty-five years of age and older from the obligation to pay New York state income tax.

sponsored.t: Provides for the exemption of disabled veterans of the armed forces of the United States from New York state thruway tolls
sponsored.sum: Provides for the exemption of disabled veterans of the armed forces of the United States from New York State Thruway tolls.

sponsored.t: Extends eligibility for the agricultural property tax credit to farmers having a leasehold interest of not fewer than five years in qualified agricultural property
sponsored.sum: Extends eligibility for the agricultural property tax credit to farmers having a leasehold interest of not fewer than five continuous years in qualified agricultural property.

sponsored.t: Relates to imposing a nursing home purchase moratorium on those who own or have owned failing facilities
sponsored.sum: Imposes a nursing home purchase moratorium on those who own or have owned failing facilities for twenty-four months since their last violation.

sponsored.t: Relates to enhanced aid and incentives for municipalities
sponsored.sum: Relates to enhanced aid and incentives for municipalities; provides that enhanced aid and incentives for municipalities will be apportioned to eligible municipalities by the director of the budget on a per-capita basis, based on population.

sponsored.t: Provides fishing and hunting tax credits for members of the United States armed forces in active service stationed within the state
sponsored.sum: Provides a personal income tax credit in the amount of any fishing and/or hunting fees paid by members of the United States armed forces in active service.

sponsored.t: Establishes the parole board accountability act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the parole board accountability act which requires incarcerated individuals who are released on parole, via a vote that is not unanimous, be placed in the community where one of the two board members primarily reside; establishes the procedure of which of the two board member's community the releasee shall be released to.

sponsored.t: Increases the number of members on the farm laborers wage board from three to five
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of members on the farm laborers wage board from three to five; adds as members the commissioner of agriculture and markets and a member appointed by the Dean of the Cornell University's College of Agriculture and Life Sciences.

sponsored.t: Exempts owners of farms and the owners of multiple dwellings from the scaffold law in certain instances
sponsored.sum: Exempts owners of farms and the owners of multiple dwellings from complying with the scaffold law in certain instances.

sponsored.t: Enacts the court order protection act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the court order protection act.

sponsored.t: Relates to dental, medical and podiatric malpractice actions and to establishing a limitation on noneconomic damages in personal injury actions
sponsored.sum: Requires a certificate of merit in actions for damages, contribution or indemnity arising out of alleged negligence of a professional licensed pursuant to the education law; establishes a party in an action for medical, dental or podiatric malpractice may not omit the name of certain experts in responding to a request; limits judgments for past and future damages in an action to recover damages for dental, medical or podiatric malpractice; limits compensation for noneconomic damages suffered by an injured plaintiff in any personal injury action to $250,000.

sponsored.t: Allows for online publication of public notices
sponsored.sum: Allows for online publication of public notices.

sponsored.t: Relates to a school resource officer program
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a school resource officer program to permit the employment of retired law enforcement officers and provide grants to school districts and non-public schools for such purpose.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the New York state department of taxation and finance from charging a fee for applications for a certificate of registration pursuant to a registration program
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the New York state department of taxation and finance from charging a fee for applications for a certificate of registration pursuant to a re-registration program.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Unpredictable Nursing Home Inspection Act
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to conduct 40% of its inspections on nursing homes outside of business hours; requires department of health inspections of nursing homes to be conducted without prior notice to a nursing home; requires an annual nursing home inspection report.

sponsored.t: Makes the extension of certain local emergency orders subject to the approval of the local governing body
sponsored.sum: Makes a proclamation extending a local state of emergency issued by the chief executive subject to the approval of the local governing body of the applicable county, city, town or village; provides that all orders issued by a local board of health shall be effective for a period of five days; requires approval by the applicable local governing body for each extension thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to gun license applications not containing warnings
sponsored.sum: Requires that no applications, or the literature given therewith, shall be approved, distributed or used in any capacity if they contain an explicit written warning regarding ownership or use of a firearm.

sponsored.t: Provides that the issue of military deployment shall not be considered as a factor in the awarding of custody in marital actions where a suitable child care plan is presented
sponsored.sum: Provides that the issue of military deployment shall not be considered as a factor in the awarding of custody in marital actions where a suitable child care plan is presented.

sponsored.t: Requires that recipients of public assistance benefits must be residents of the state for at least ninety days prior to applying for such benefits
sponsored.sum: Requires that recipients of public assistance benefits must be residents of the state for at least ninety days prior to applying for such benefits.

sponsored.t: Establishes the civil rights restoration act and amends provisions of law regarding firearm licenses; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the civil rights restoration act; amends provisions regarding firearm licenses and destruction of firearms; exempts certain individuals from providing photographs in order to obtain a firearm license; expands the definition of immediate family.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of person for the purposes of homicide
sponsored.sum: Designates the definition of person for the purposes of homicide as Mya's law.

sponsored.t: Repeals the Empire state film production credit and the Empire state film post production credit
sponsored.sum: Repeals the Empire state film production credit and the Empire state film post production credit.

sponsored.t: Provides that written notice of premium rate changes be given not less than sixty days prior to the effective date of such rate changes
sponsored.sum: Provides written notice of premium rate changes not less than sixty days prior to the effective date of such rate changes.

sponsored.t: Creates the crime of stolen valor
sponsored.sum: Creates the crime of stolen valor; makes such crime a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Expands the definition of the offense of murder in the first degree to include murder occurring after an attempt to commit certain sexual offenses
sponsored.sum: Relates to murder in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to security and protection of New York national guard recruiting centers
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of military and naval affairs to establish policies relating to security and protection of New York national guard and air national guard recruiting centers.

sponsored.t: Relates to public financing for state office; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to public financing for state office; provides limitations on contributions to candidates for election to any public office in the state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Pavilion in Genesee county to share and hold justice court in the town of Covington in Wyoming county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Pavilion in Genesee county to share and hold justice court in the town of Covington in Wyoming county.

sponsored.t: Relates to the internet sale of raffle tickets
sponsored.sum: Relates to the internet sale of raffle tickets.

sponsored.t: Reduces the amount a utility can be assessed for costs and expenses of the department of public service and the public service commission from one percent to one-third of one percent
sponsored.sum: Reduces the total amount that can be charged from one percent to one-third of one percent.

sponsored.t: Relates to information to be reported by registered sex offenders
sponsored.sum: Requires the employment address of certain sex offenders to be reported to the division of criminal justice services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits any sex offender from residing within a quarter mile of any school, playground, park or building in which child day care is provided
sponsored.sum: Prohibits any sex offender from residing within a quarter mile of any school, playground, park or building in which child day care is provided.

sponsored.t: Provides that each fire district, department or company required to provide enhanced cancer disability benefits for volunteer fire fighters shall be entitled to reimbursement by the state
sponsored.sum: Provides that each fire district, department or company required to provide enhanced cancer disability benefits for volunteer fire fighters pursuant to section two hundred five-cc of the general municipal law shall be entitled to reimbursement by the state for payments made in order to obtain the insurance coverage necessary to satisfy the requirements of section two hundred five-cc of the general municipal law.

sponsored.t: Preferences under the affordable home ownership development program for service related disabled veterans
sponsored.sum: Provides for preferences under the affordable home ownership development program for service related disabled veterans.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crimes of vehicular assault and vehicular manslaughter in an active work zone and intrusion into an active work zone
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of vehicular assault and vehicular manslaughter in an active work zone and intrusion into an active work zone.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a space on a certificate of title for an owner to designate a beneficiary to whom the vehicle shall be transferred upon the death of the owner
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing a space on a certificate of title for an owner to designate a beneficiary to whom the vehicle shall be transferred upon the death of the owner.

sponsored.t: Provides that a person is guilty of harassment in the first degree if such person strikes, shoves, kicks, et cetera a school employee
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person is guilty of harassment in the first degree, a class B misdemeanor, when such person strikes, shoves, kicks or otherwise subjects a school employee to physical contact or attempts or threatens to do the same while such school employee is engaged in the performance of such person's duties as a school employee.

sponsored.t: Relates to building new one-family residential construction
sponsored.sum: Relates to building new one-family residential construction.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating every government entity which issues licenses to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms as participating agencies for voter registration form distribution and assistance
sponsored.sum: Relates to designating every government entity which issues licenses to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms as participating agencies for voter registration form distribution and assistance.

sponsored.t: Increases width and weight of the description specifics for an all terrain vehicle
sponsored.sum: Increases width and weight of the description specifics for an all terrain vehicle.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the transfer of unexpended moneys from funds receiving moneys from a dedicated fee into any other fund
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the transfer of unexpended moneys from funds receiving moneys from a dedicated fee into any other fund.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the abatement of municipal and school real property taxes in certain cases of catastrophic loss and establishes procedures therefor
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the abatement of real property taxes in certain cases of catastrophic loss; establishes procedures therefor; limits eligibility to one, two, or three family houses; applies to all municipal and school taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the state mortgage agency to purchase veterans' assisted forward commitment mortgages from banks within the state
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state mortgage agency to purchase veterans' assisted forward commitment mortgages from banks within the state; requires the board of directors of the state mortgage agency to establish income limits for eligible veterans from time to time.

sponsored.t: Establishes the pipeline investment for public environmental solutions program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the pipeline investment for public environmental solutions program for the purpose of making payments toward the replacement and rehabilitation of existing local municipally-owned and funded drinking water, stormwater and sanitary sewer systems; makes such program eligible for funding from the Clean water, clean air and green jobs environmental bond act of 2022.

sponsored.t: Allows excess continuing education credit hours for real estate brokers and real estate salespersons to be carried forward to the next two-year licensing period
sponsored.sum: Allows up to seven excess continuing education credit hours for real estate brokers and real estate salespersons to be carried forward to the next two-year licensing period.

sponsored.t: Relates to the granting of certificates for the construction or operation of industrial wind turbines
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the granting of a certificate for the construction or operation of an on-shore or off-shore industrial wind turbine or wind farm within the jurisdiction and control of the state and within any area of the state outside of the city of New York unless a certificate for the construction or operation of an on-shore or off-shore industrial wind turbine or wind farm within geographic boundaries of or the shoreline adjacent to the city of New York is granted simultaneously.

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of sales tax in the county of Orleans
sponsored.sum: Extends the period during which the county of Orleans is authorized to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Batavia to alienate certain parklands for use as a municipal parking lot and to preserve the historic Brisbane mansion
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Batavia to alienate certain parklands for use as a municipal parking lot and to preserve the historic Brisbane mansion.

sponsored.t: Amends chapter 530 of the laws of 2024, amending the tax law relating to authorizing an occupancy tax in the village of Medina, in relation to the effectiveness thereof
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the village of Medina to impose an occupancy tax.

sponsored.t: Relates to the purposes of the Brockport Exempt Volunteer Firefighters' Benevolent Association, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Changes the name of the Brockport Exempt Volunteer Firemen's Benevolent Association, Inc.; expands the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes by such organization.

sponsored.t: Relates to dedicating a portion of the state highway system to Specialist Jason Johnston
sponsored.sum: Relates to dedicating a portion of the state highway system to Specialist Jason Johnston.

sponsored.t: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Genesee to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Genesee to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax from 11/30/2025 to 11/30/2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Genesee to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Genesee to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property until November 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a district court system in the county of Orleans
sponsored.sum: Establishes a district court system in the county of Orleans; provides for its organization, jurisdiction and procedures.

sponsored.t: Creates a wage tax credit for employers who employ New York national guard members, reservists, volunteer firefighters and EMS personnel
sponsored.sum: Creates a $1,500 wage tax credit for employers who employ New York national guard members, reservists, volunteer firefighters and EMS personnel.

sponsored.t: Relates to volunteer members of village fire companies
sponsored.sum: Relates to volunteer members of village fire companies.

sponsored.t: Extends tuition free course benefits to volunteer firefighters or volunteer ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Extends tuition free course benefits to volunteer firefighters or voluntary ambulance workers; authorizes the board of trustees of the state university to regulate the conferral of such benefits.
